title: The Summary Justice (Social Contributions) Act 2025
version: As Amended from Time to Time

sections.title: Late for Duty
sections.description: Applies where an officer reports for duty after their scheduled commencement time. The applicable contribution may increase proportionate to the duration of lateness.

sections.title: Attendance on Incorrect Day
sections.description: Applies where an officer attends for duty on a rest day or non-working day in error.

sections.title: Pre-Annual Leave Contribution
sections.description: Applies to the final tour of duty immediately preceding a period of annual leave.

sections.title: Transfer Out Contribution
sections.description: Applies where an officer departs the team for another department, division, or posting.

sections.title: Arrival from Elsewhere Contribution
sections.description: Applies where an officer joins the team from another department, division, or posting.

sections.title: Birthday (Personal)
sections.description: Applies on the occasion of an officer’s birthday.

sections.title: Birthday (Work Anniversary)
sections.description: Applies on the anniversary of joining the service or team.

sections.title: Return from Prolonged Absence
sections.description: Applies where an officer returns to duty following extended sickness, leave, or other authorised absence.

sections.title: Relationship Status Alteration
sections.description: Applies upon marriage, engagement, divorce, or other significant and publicly acknowledged relationship change.

sections.title: Birth of Child
sections.description: Applies upon the arrival of a child into the officer’s household.

sections.title: Resolved Complaint
sections.description: Applies where a complaint has been concluded in the officer’s favour or otherwise resolved.

sections.title: Unlawful or Regrettable Arrest
sections.description: Applies where an arrest is subsequently deemed inappropriate, unlawful, or otherwise ill-advised.

sections.title: General Operational Error
sections.description: Applies to minor but notable mistakes, lapses in judgement, or administrative mishaps.

sections.title: Speeding Notice (On or Off Duty)
sections.description: Applies where an officer receives a speeding notice or is otherwise detected exceeding lawful limits.

sections.title: Excessive Personal Calls
sections.description: Applies where more than three personal calls are made or received during a single tour of duty.

sections.title: False Activation of Emergency Button
sections.description: Applies where the emergency activation red button is activated without sufficient operational cause.

sections.title: Tactical Deployment (Stinger)
sections.description: Applies where a stinger device is deployed during operational duties.

sections.title: Vehicle Collision
sections.description: Applies where a police vehicle is involved in a collision or impact event, regardless of fault.

sections.title: Escape of Detainee
sections.description: Applies where a detained person escapes lawful custody.

sections.title: Loss of Equipment
sections.description: Applies where issued equipment is misplaced, lost, or otherwise unaccounted for.

sections.title: Notable Death Attendance
sections.description: Applies following attendance at a death presenting unusual or particularly memorable circumstances.

sections.title: Saving of Life
sections.description: Applies where an officer’s actions contribute directly to the preservation of life.

sections.title: Serious or Complex Arrest
sections.description: Applies where an arrest is of particular seriousness, complexity, or notoriety.

sections.title: PAVA or Taser Deployment
sections.description: Applies where incapacitant spray or Taser is deployed during operational duties. Contribution level may increase proportionate to accidental colleague exposure.

sections.title: Lottery or Financial Windfall
sections.description: Applies upon the receipt of significant unexpected financial gain.

sections.title: Award or Commendation
sections.description: Applies upon receipt of formal recognition or commendation.

sections.title: Promotion
sections.description: Applies upon advancement in rank or role.

sections.title: Amendment of the Act
sections.description: Applies where an officer proposes or enacts an amendment to this Act.

sections.title: COVID-Related Absence
sections.description: Applies where time off is taken due to COVID-related absence.

sections.title: Minor Fabrication (Non-Serious Context)
sections.description: Applies where an officer is found to have exaggerated, embellished, or misrepresented matters in a clearly non-serious context.
